title: Production platform baseline
context: The production subscription hosts the customer-facing API and its data platform. The baseline the platform team agreed on for every production resource: no public network access on data and secret stores, private endpoints to reach them, workloads under managed identities, an owner tag, one region, and zone-redundant storage.
decision: Production data and secret stores disable public network access and are reached over approved private endpoints; compute runs under a managed identity; every resource carries an owner tag; every resource lives in centralus; production storage accounts use a zone-redundant SKU.
decisionDrivers: Data exfiltration through public endpoints is the top threat in the platform threat model
Secrets in app settings were the cause of the last two incidents
Cost allocation needs an owner on every resource
consequences: Private DNS zones and endpoints per data store
A second region needs a new decision
assumptions: Production resources carry the tag env=prod
risks: Resources created outside the platform pipeline may drift

claims.statement: Production data and secret stores disable public network access
Production data and secret stores are reached over an approved private endpoint
Production compute runs under a managed identity
Every resource carries an owner tag
Production storage accounts use a zone-redundant SKU
